description: Header file defining the InspectableNativeWindow class for managing Windows Runtime native windows with Direct3D 11 and WinRT, including methods for swap chain creation, client rect management, and property retrieval.

classes.name: InspectableNativeWindow
classes.description: A class for managing Windows Runtime native windows, supporting swap chain creation, resize handling, and property management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to initialize the native window with a given EGL window and property set.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a Direct3D swap chain with specified parameters.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the current client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: setNewClientSize
methods.description: Sets a new client size, updating the client rect and applying scale if necessary.

methods.name: scaleSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to scale the swap chain based on window size and client rect.

methods.name: clientRect
methods.description: Calculates the client rectangle based on window size.
